description:
Add the named extended BCH constructor used by OSD conformance and campaign work against the implementation-produced reference identity.

## Background

The existing named-constructor family stops at eBCH $(64,57)$. The pinned published source fixes dimensions, minimum distance, and systematic convention only; the primitive polynomial and field representation are a recorded campaign decision consumed by this factory, and the published curves are invariant under that permutation-equivalent representation choice.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `ExtendedBchCode::ebch_128_64()` constructs the recorded primitive BCH extension with $n=128$, $k=64$, and systematic generator form.
- [hard] REQ-02: A committed fixture records the chosen primitive polynomial, its decision provenance, and canonical serialized generator and parity-check matrices.
- [hard] REQ-03: Tests verify fixture identity, matrix dimensions, orthogonality, systematic encoding, and even extension parity.
- [hard] REQ-04: Public rustdoc cites construction provenance and demonstrates the named factory workflow.
title: Named eBCH(128,64) reference factory
